name: Anne
source: [spoiler]A being who feeds on emotions of dreaming people. She impersonates Ritsuki's older sister in his dreams. She has put Ritsuki in a coma-like state in order to spare him the sorrow of learning about his sister's death, and to be closer to him.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]A being who feeds on emotions of dreaming people. She impersonates Ritsuki's older sister in his dreams. She has put Ritsuki in a coma-like state in order to spare him the sorrow of learning about his sister's death, and to be closer to him.[/spoiler]
